headline: Nvidia share buyback plan gets $150 billion boost
detail: This is a massive vote of confidence from Nvidia, signaling strong belief in its future. It's a huge positive for the chip sector and tech overall, potentially boosting sentiment for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: NVDA has a "WATCH" scanner setup (entry 225.7-225.47, stop 223.14). Consider initiating a new position if you want more exposure to this strong catalyst.

headline: Treasury yields edge higher amid pressure on global government bonds
detail: Rising Treasury yields make future earnings less valuable, which typically hurts growth-oriented tech stocks. This creates a headwind for your highly concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially with margin.
rec: Review your leveraged positions like SOXL and SPAL. Higher yields make their recovery even harder, increasing the urgency to manage these deep losses.

headline: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead enterprise unit. MongoDB shares crater
detail: While not directly in your holdings, this shows how specific company news can cause sharp moves in tech. MongoDB's drop highlights sector-specific risks even amidst broader positive news.
rec: No direct trade. This is a reminder to stay vigilant on individual tech names, even those not directly in your book, as sentiment can spread.
